reason: The README clearly describes a plugin whose primary purpose is inspecting image attachments or files with a configured vision model and providing text descriptions to text-only agents.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的视觉模型分析聊天附件或本地图片文件，并为文本模型返回图片描述。
summaries.en: Uses a configured vision model to analyze chat attachments or local image files and return descriptions to text-only models.

capabilities: Reads image files supplied to the describe_image tool
Sends image content to a configured vision-capable model through the harness LLM runtime
Transforms image attachments into text descriptions for text-only conversation models
Installs or patches host integration to admit and process image attachments
